WITH budget_line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
           COUNT(x.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_spend
    FROM budget_line_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT t.total_cost, t.expense_count, a.avg_spend
    FROM budget_line_totals AS t
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a
    WHERE t.total_cost > a.avg_spend
)
SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total,
       SUM(expense_count) AS total_expenses,
       AVG(total_cost - avg_spend) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;
